картина: Блог-пост Google DeepMind от 29.08.2023 о запуске беты SynthID вместе с Google Cloud для клиентов Vertex AI, использующих Imagen. Аудитория — широкая публика и клиенты облака. Моделей Gemini/Nano Banana на странице нет, только Imagen. Структура: анонс, зачем нужна идентификация, почему обычные водяные знаки не годятся, механизм (две обученные вместе модели, знак в пикселях), устойчивость к фильтрам/цвету/JPEG, три уровня уверенности, сравнение с метаданными, планы. Повторный акцент: знак незаметен, но распознаётся, и при этом 'not foolproof' / 'isn't perfect'. Термины: 'synthetic imagery', 'imperceptible watermark', 'three confidence levels'.

единицы.утверждение_en: SynthID is a tool that watermarks and identifies synthetic images created by Imagen.
единицы.цитата: New tool helps watermark and identify synthetic images created by Imagen
единицы.заметка: Статья 2023 года; речь только об Imagen, не о Gemini/Nano Banana.

единицы.утверждение_en: On 2023-08-29 Google DeepMind, in partnership with Google Cloud, launched a beta version of SynthID for watermarking and identifying AI-generated images.
единицы.цитата: Today, in partnership with Google Cloud , we’re launching a beta version of SynthID , a tool for watermarking and identifying AI-generated images.

единицы.утверждение_en: SynthID embeds a digital watermark directly into the pixels of an image, imperceptible to the human eye but detectable for identification.
единицы.цитата: This technology embeds a digital watermark directly into the pixels of an image, making it imperceptible to the human eye, but detectable for identification.
единицы.заметка: Ключевой механизм: знак в пикселях, а не в метаданных (см. E-178-19).

единицы.утверждение_en: At launch SynthID was released to a limited number of Vertex AI customers using Imagen, a text-to-image model that creates photorealistic images from input text.
единицы.цитата: SynthID is being released to a limited number of Vertex AI customers using Imagen , one of our latest text-to-image models that uses input text to create photorealistic images.

единицы.утверждение_en: SynthID is meant to let AI-generated images — and even some edited versions of them — be identified at a later date.
единицы.цитата: Part of this responsibility is giving users more advanced tools for identifying AI-generated images so their images — and even some edited versions — can be identified at a later date.
единицы.заметка: 'some edited versions' — не все правки сохраняют распознаваемость.

единицы.утверждение_en: SynthID was developed by Google DeepMind and refined in partnership with Google Research; Google Cloud is described as the first cloud provider to offer a tool for creating AI-generated images responsibly and identifying them.
единицы.цитата: This technology is grounded in our approach to developing and deploying responsible AI, and was developed by Google DeepMind and refined in partnership with Google Research.
единицы.заметка: Утверждение про 'first cloud provider' — в предыдущем предложении того же абзаца.

единицы.утверждение_en: SynthID is not foolproof against extreme image manipulations.
единицы.цитата: SynthID isn’t foolproof against extreme image manipulations, but it does provide a promising technical approach for empowering people and organisations to work with AI-generated content responsibly.

единицы.утверждение_en: As of 2023, SynthID could evolve to other AI models and modalities beyond imagery, such as audio, video and text.
единицы.цитата: This tool could also evolve alongside other AI models and modalities beyond imagery such as audio, video, and text.

единицы.утверждение_en: Traditional stamp-like watermarks are insufficient for AI images because they can easily be edited out; for example, a corner watermark can be cropped out with basic editing.
единицы.цитата: Traditional watermarks aren’t sufficient for identifying AI-generated images because they’re often applied like a stamp on an image and can easily be edited out. For example, discrete watermarks found in the corner of an image can be cropped out with basic editing techniques.
единицы.раздел: New type of watermark for AI images

единицы.утверждение_en: Watermark design must balance imperceptibility against robustness: highly visible watermarks pose aesthetic problems for creative or commercial use, while some earlier imperceptible watermarks are lost through simple edits like resizing.
единицы.цитата: Finding the right balance between imperceptibility and robustness to image manipulations is difficult. Highly visible watermarks, often added as a layer with a name or logo across the top of an image, also present aesthetic challenges for creative or commercial purposes. Likewise, some previously developed imperceptible watermarks can be lost through simple editing techniques like resizing.
единицы.раздел: New type of watermark for AI images

единицы.утверждение_en: SynthID is designed not to compromise image quality and to remain detectable after modifications such as adding filters, changing colours, and saving with lossy compression (most commonly JPEG).
единицы.цитата: We designed SynthID so it doesn't compromise image quality, and allows the watermark to remain detectable, even after modifications like adding filters, changing colours, and saving with various lossy compression schemes — most commonly used for JPEGs.
единицы.раздел: New type of watermark for AI images
единицы.заметка: Подпись к иллюстрации добавляет изменение яркости: 'adding filters, changing colours and brightness'.

единицы.утверждение_en: SynthID uses two deep learning models, one for watermarking and one for identifying, trained together on diverse images and optimised both for correct identification and for imperceptibility by visually aligning the watermark to the original content.
единицы.цитата: SynthID uses two deep learning models — for watermarking and identifying — that have been trained together on a diverse set of images. The combined model is optimised on a range of objectives, including correctly identifying watermarked content and improving imperceptibility by visually aligning the watermark to the original content.
единицы.раздел: New type of watermark for AI images
единицы.заметка: Механизм: пара обученных вместе моделей; знак подстраивается под содержимое картинки.

единицы.утверждение_en: SynthID is not perfect, but Google's internal testing shows it is accurate against many common image manipulations.
единицы.цитата: While this technology isn’t perfect, our internal testing shows that it’s accurate against many common image manipulations.
единицы.заметка: Цифр точности нет; основание — внутреннее тестирование Google.

единицы.утверждение_en: Watermarking: SynthID can add an imperceptible watermark to synthetic images produced by Imagen.
единицы.цитата: Watermarking : SynthID can add an imperceptible watermark to synthetic images produced by Imagen.
единицы.раздел: Robust and scalable approach — SynthID's combined approach

единицы.утверждение_en: Identification: SynthID scans an image for its digital watermark and assesses the likelihood that the image was created by Imagen.
единицы.цитата: Identification : By scanning an image for its digital watermark, SynthID can assess the likelihood of an image being created by Imagen.
единицы.раздел: Robust and scalable approach — SynthID's combined approach
единицы.заметка: Результат — вероятность, а не бинарный ответ.

единицы.утверждение_en: SynthID identification returns one of three confidence levels; if a watermark is detected, part of the image is likely generated by Imagen.
единицы.цитата: This tool provides three confidence levels for interpreting the results of watermark identification. If a digital watermark is detected, part of the image is likely generated by Imagen.
единицы.заметка: Названия трёх уровней и пороги на странице не даны. 'part of the image' — детекция может относиться к части картинки (например, после редактирования).

единицы.утверждение_en: Metadata is one of the most widely used methods for identifying content: it stores information such as who created a file and when, and digital signatures in metadata can show if an image has been changed.
единицы.цитата: One of the most widely used methods of identifying content is through metadata, which provides information such as who created it and when. This information is stored with the image file. Digital signatures added to metadata can then show if an image has been changed.

единицы.утверждение_en: Metadata can be manually removed or lost when files are edited.
единицы.цитата: However, metadata can be manually removed or even lost when files are edited.

единицы.утверждение_en: Because SynthID's watermark is embedded in pixels, it is compatible with metadata-based identification and remains detectable even when metadata is lost.
единицы.цитата: Since SynthID’s watermark is embedded in the pixels of an image, it’s compatible with other image identification approaches that are based on metadata, and remains detectable even when metadata is lost.

единицы.утверждение_en: As of 2023, Google planned possible expansion of SynthID to other AI models, integration into more Google products, and availability to third parties in the near future.
единицы.цитата: SynthID could be expanded for use across other AI models and we’re excited about the potential of integrating it into more Google products and making it available to third parties in the near future

единицы.утверждение_en: The model used to produce the synthetic images shown in the blog may differ from the model used on Imagen and Vertex AI.
единицы.цитата: Note: The model used for producing synthetic images in this blog may be different from the model used on Imagen and Vertex AI.
единицы.заметка: Иллюстрации статьи не обязательно отражают продуктовую модель.

единицы.утверждение_en: The robustness illustration shows the watermarked butterfly image modified by blur, grayscale, blue tint, rotation, color filters, noise and brightness adjustments.
единицы.цитата: An eight-panel grid showing different modified versions of a purple butterfly image, demonstrating variations like blur, grayscale, blue tint, rotation, color filters, noise, and brightness adjustments.
единицы.раздел: New type of watermark for AI images — иллюстрация
единицы.заметка: Alt перечисляет виды правок на иллюстрации; результат детекции по каждой правке в тексте не дан — прямо заявлены только фильтры, цвета, яркость, lossy-сжатие (E-178-11).

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: Across the page SynthID detection is presented as probabilistic, not proof: it is 'not foolproof', 'isn't perfect', reports a likelihood with three confidence levels, and a detection means only that part of the image is likely AI-generated.

The page positions pixel watermarking and metadata as complementary layers: metadata is lost on edits, while the pixel watermark survives metadata loss but not extreme manipulation, so neither alone is complete.
As of the page date (2023-08-29) SynthID covered only Imagen images for a limited set of Vertex AI customers in beta; the page says nothing about Gemini or Nano Banana image models.
длинная_дистанция.заметка: Для правил по Gemini-моделям страница даёт только механизм SynthID; применимость к Nano Banana — из других страниц.

не_сказано: Не названы три уровня уверенности и их пороги.
Нет цифр точности детекции; только 'internal testing'.
Не сказано, какие манипуляции 'extreme'; про кадрирование сказано только для обычных видимых знаков, для SynthID — нет.
Не сказано, можно ли отключить водяной знак и влияет ли он на последующее редактирование картинки.
Ничего о Gemini/Nano Banana, C2PA, видимом водяном знаке.
сомнения: Статья 2023 года про Imagen; к моделям Nano Banana относится только общий механизм SynthID (по пометке партии).
Статус 'beta' и ограниченный доступ актуальны на 2023-08-29; позднее состояние по этой странице неизвестно (html modified_time 2026-07-06, но текст выглядит неизменным).
